title: Upgrade Difference Charges on Monthly-Billed Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
A monthly-billed Rental Property Service Contracts contract moved to a higher tier part-way through a billing period is billed an upgrade difference charge for the rest of that period, as one upgrade charge. A monthly-billed contract upgraded part-way through a billing period is also billed the difference for the rest of that period, while the new tier's installment is billed from the next billing period.

## When the charge is fixed

No upgrade difference charge is fixed until the installment for the first billing period at the new tier stands billed on the contract.

In the same terms: while no installment stands billed on the contract for the first billing period at the new tier, the upgrade difference charge is not fixed.

## What the records show afterwards

One upgrade proration charge in the contract's billing history covering the recorded plan change date through the last day of the billing period in which the tier changed; the premium balance rises by the charge.

## Invocation: `bill_upgrade_difference_aa78d3be`

**Capability.** One call adds one upgrade proration charge (charge type `upgrade_proration`) to the contract's billing history, dated today, covering the recorded plan change date through the period end date given, and raises the contract's premium balance by the charge. The landlord sees the charge on the billing history and a higher balance owed.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `bill_upgrade_difference_aa78d3be` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `landlord_contract_id` | the rental property service contract number of the upgraded contract, as returned by the rental contract lookup for the landlord | identifier text |
| `difference_amount` | the upgrade difference charge | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |
| `portfolio_discount_rate` | the portfolio discount rate the charge records | decimal fraction with 2 decimal places, for example 0.05; 0.00 when none |
| `billing_period_end` | the last day of the billing period in which the tier changed, copied from that period's installment in the billing history | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "billed"; `billing_entry_id`, the new charge reference; `landlord_contract_id`; `charge_type` "upgrade_proration"; `billing_period_start` and `billing_period_end` as YYYY-MM-DD; `amount` in USD with 2 decimal places; and `premium_balance`, the balance owed once the charge is added, in USD with 2 decimal places.

*Hypothetical receipt:* a charge of 5.92 with period end 14 May returns `charge_type` "upgrade_proration", the period from the plan change date to 14 May, and the premium balance raised by 5.92.
